name: matrix-deepseek-harness-companion
description: Run DeepSeek Harness in VS Code with optional keyless local MCP web search instead of DeepSeek Search/Fetch.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Harness can edit files and run commands. Trust the workspace before starting it.

commands.title: DeepSeek Harness: Set DeepSeek API Key
DeepSeek Harness: Copy Selection as Context

deepseekHarness.binaryPath.description: Path to the dsh executable. Leave empty to try dsh from PATH, then npx @deepseek-ai/dsh.

deepseekHarness.dshHome.description: Optional DSH_HOME. Leave empty to use the official Harness default.

deepseekHarness.launchWithNpx.description: Offer to download and run official @deepseek-ai/dsh through npx when dsh is not found.

deepseekHarness.hidePreviewBadge.description: Hide the Preview badge in the embedded Harness interface. This does not change the upstream release status.

deepseekHarness.localSearch.enabled.description: Use the bundled local-search MCP and disable the paid DeepSeek web-search provider for Companion-launched Harness sessions.

deepseekHarness.localSearch.provider.description: Local search backend. Bing RSS and DuckDuckGo require no key; SearXNG uses your configured instance.

deepseekHarness.localSearch.searxngUrl.description: SearXNG base URL. Its JSON search format must be enabled.

deepseekHarness.localSearch.nodePath.description: Node.js 24.5+ executable used to launch the bundled local-search MCP server and honor HTTP(S)_PROXY.

deepseekHarness.localSearch.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for each search or page fetch.

deepseekHarness.localSearch.maxFetchByte.description: Maximum number of bytes read from one web page.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check mcp/local-web-search-server.js && node scripts/test-local-web-search.js && node scripts/validate-publish.js --allow-local
